title: Turn the table, lose the wobble
hook: Can a turn help this square equal-leg table?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: The illustrated signed gap crosses zero during a quarter turn. For square equal-leg tables on suitably gentle continuous ground, a balanced position exists.

claims.source: Baritompa, Löwen, Polster & Ross, Mathematical table turning revisited, full text opened 2026-10-14 at https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0511490. Square equal-leg table, continuous ground and slope/leg length conditions; proof of sign change and balanced position. Our cosine gap is an illustration, not a solution of the full contact geometry.

claims.text: Four feet down is not level. Clear hot drinks before turning; steps, holes and unequal legs fall outside this model.
